title: Specialists — how a permission request sits on its card

steps.path: Status bar → "1 needs you" → a specialist waiting for your OK
steps.headline: Which way should a specialist's permission request sit on its card?
steps.notice: References: both new versions use the slim notice box with its buttons inside, the look you approved for Cloud provider cards. The Yes / Always allow / No buttons are the same ones the chat's own permission prompt uses.
steps.risk: Nothing changes in the chat itself; only the Specialists popup.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: The whole card turns amber, and the request is a tinted strip welded to the card's bottom edge.

variants.label: Notice at the bottom
variants.summary: The card keeps its normal outline. The request is a slim amber notice box inside the card, after Briefing and Activity, with its buttons on the same line.
variants.risk: With Activity opened, the request can be pushed below the fold of the popup.

variants.label: Notice at the top
variants.summary: The same notice box, right under the specialist's name, before what it's doing and its Briefing and Activity.
variants.risk: It separates the name from the one-line "what it's doing" under it.
